statements.text: Mix $+100$ and $+1000$ taps, even though only the $+1000$ button is available.
Call the answer "presses" and stop before finding how many $+1000$ taps make $9000$.

stem:
Sameer's calculator starts at $0$ and has only a $+1000$ button. He wants the display to show exactly $9000$.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Only +1000 is available, so 9000 needs 9 presses. Statement 2 invents a second button. Statement 3 stops at the word presses without the count.
